items.story:
大立光短期營運受智慧型手機新機拉貨動能趨緩影響，加上新產
品良率及綠電採購成本壓力，預期第四季營收及獲利表現仍相對
保守。展望2027 年，手機主鏡頭持續朝高規格升級，有利公司
發揮精密光學設計與製造優勢；另一方面，FAU 預計於2H27
進入量產，隨CPO 技術逐步發展，有望成為中長期新增營收來
源。考量大立光具備高精度光學製造、微米級對位技術及自動化
設備開發能力，技術門檻高且具備跨領域應用優勢，正面看待公
司中長期發展。綜合以上，研究部預估大立光2027 年營業收入
為706.92 億元，Y+17.08%，毛利率51.37%，Y+4.53ppts，
營業利益率40.04%，Y+4.98ppts，稅後純益268.24 億元，
Y+24.96%，EPS 為205.08 元。研究部考量儘管2026 年消費
性電子需求疲弱，且CPO 產品短期營收貢獻仍有限，然而進度
優於先前預期，隨新產品逐步放量，2027 年營運有望重回成長
軌道，給予大立光38 倍本益比評價，目標價訂為7,800 元，投
資建議為買進。

items.story:
Taiflex’s share price has outperformed Taiwan CCL names by >60% since June
(EMC/TUC +11%/-15%, Taiex +4%) due to industry expectations (per our
conversations with investors and channel checks) that Nvidia might use a PTFE
+M9/10 prepreg hybrid for the Rubin Ultra NVL576 Switch Board instead of M10
CCL. The PTFE debate has resurfaced in recent months due to Nvidia’s reported
pursuit of next-gen CCL with <0.0004 Df, which is more readily achieved via the
PTFE route than the epoxy/glass route. That said, the PTFE route
continues to have drawbacks, including weak mechanical stability and processing
difficulties/low board yield, which increases production costs. NPC remains
confident in the performance of its epoxy-based M10 samples that were previously
submitted. In the event that Nvidia were to choose a PTFE hybrid, NPC has an
historical track record in PTFE CCL production and has been awarded multiple
patents over the past 10 years, with low-df PTFE CCL for microwave components
listed in its product catalog since 2021 at least. We believe this has been largely
overlooked by the investment community and even industry insiders. We outline
our thoughts on the PTFE debate below and raise our FY26E/27E NP by 20%/68%
to reflect accelerating tightness in the copper foil and CCL market, given recent
price and processing margin hikes (nothing to do with PTFE). This results in a
revised Dec-27 PT of NT$350.

conversations with investors and channel checks) that Nvidia might use a PTFE
+M9/10 prepreg hybrid for the Rubin Ultra NVL576 Switch Board instead of M10
CCL. The PTFE debate has resurfaced in recent months due to Nvidia’s reported
pursuit of next-gen CCL with <0.0004 Df, which is more readily achieved via the
PTFE route than the epoxy/glass route. That said, the PTFE route
continues to have drawbacks, including weak mechanical stability and processing
difficulties/low board yield, which increases production costs. NPC remains
confident in the performance of its epoxy-based M10 samples that were previously
submitted. In the event that Nvidia were to choose a PTFE hybrid, NPC has an
historical track record in PTFE CCL production and has been awarded multiple
patents over the past 10 years, with low-df PTFE CCL for microwave components
listed in its product catalog since 2021 at least. We believe this has been largely
overlooked by the investment community and even industry insiders. We outline
our thoughts on the PTFE debate below and raise our FY26E/27E NP by 20%/68%
to reflect accelerating tightness in the copper foil and CCL market, given recent
price and processing margin hikes (nothing to do with PTFE). This results in a
revised Dec-27 PT of NT$350.

南亞科法說會展望如預期正向，包括：(1)3Q26獲利亮眼，ASP季增
超過六十位數%，毛利率較前季提升+6.2pt至85.7%，符合市場預期。
(2)預期4Q26供不應求狀況持續，ASP預計將持續溫和改善。(3) DDR4
佔整體Dram需求的12%～14%，南亞科整體市占率為低個位數%，預期
2027年仍存在缺口。(4)當前AI伺服器及基礎建設相關營收佔比20%，
目標於2029~2030年提升至40%~50%。在投資建議上，儘管AI強勁需
求帶動記憶體循環周期較過去更長，且2027年因設備交期因素限制
供給，使得Dram市場供需依舊緊缺，但考量：(1)記憶體價格及GM基
期已高，(2)國際記憶體大廠LTA普遍設定價格上下限，(3)長期下DDR4
市場勢必逐步縮小，因此對於報價漲幅逐步趨緩看法不變。預估2026、
2027年稅後EPS分別為76.12元及127.9元，每股淨值分別為146.5
元及244.0元。目前PBR 2.2X高於過去上緣1.8X，故維持中立建議。

We reiterate Buy on Largan, and raise our TP to TWD8,300, based on 30x 2028F EPS of
TWD276.7 (previously: TWD6,000, on 25x 2028F EPS of TWD240.0). We cut our earnings
forecasts by 7.2% and 10.4% for 2026F and 2027F, respectively, to reflect the adverse
impact of rising BOM costs on smartphone demand and potential cannibalization of the 18
Pro series by the iPhone Duo. For the first time we incorporate the co-packaged optics fiber
array unit (CPO FAU) revenue into our earnings model, by assuming the new business
would contribute 1%/18% of 2027/28F earnings. Hence, our 2028F earnings imply 44%
y-y growth, driven by CPO FAU and Apple’s (AAPL US, Not rated) camera upgrades. We
raise our target P/E from 25x to 30x to reflect Largan’s smooth progress in CPO FAU and a
higher sensitivity to its earnings. Every one million units of CPO FAU could contribute
c.TWD10 EPS to Largan, in our calculation. The target P/E of 30x exceeds the high end of
the stock’s historical trading band (10-25x) since 2015. Largan trades at 35x 2027F P/E.

items.story:
Largan shares have risen 242% since April on optimism around its CPO FAU progress. 
While we stay constructive on Largan's CPO prospects, we believe the market is pricing 
in confidence ahead of still-early qualification progress, particularly given a crowded 
competitive field. Largan only starts its sample line late Q3, integrating its Prism Micro 
Lens Array and Fiber Array with AOET's V-groove and Corning's fiber. We expect several 
quarters to improve yields, gain integrator acceptance (Corning, Senko, AuthenX) and 
convert its initial production-oriented FA program into volume while competing against
incumbent TFC and vertically integrated rivals incl. Coherent. We downgrade our rating 
from Buy to Sell with CPO still at an early stage and the stock now 35x 2027 vs. LT 13-
18x range well above our sum-of-the-parts NT$5,000 PT based on 15x smartphone lens
+ 50x CPO base case for 40% share (upper end of optical peers at 14-72x).

買賣結論:Largan shares have risen 242% since April on optimism around its CPO FAU progress. 
While we stay constructive on Largan's CPO prospects, we believe the market is pricing 
in confidence ahead of still-early qualification progress, particularly given a crowded 
competitive field. Largan only starts its sample line late Q3, integrating its Prism Micro 
Lens Array and Fiber Array with AOET's V-groove and Corning's fiber. We expect several 
quarters to improve yields, gain integrator acceptance (Corning, Senko, AuthenX) and 
convert its initial production-oriented FA program into volume while competing against
incumbent TFC and vertically integrated rivals incl. Coherent. We downgrade our rating 
from Buy to Sell with CPO still at an early stage and the stock now 35x 2027 vs. LT 13-
18x range well above our sum-of-the-parts NT$5,000 PT based on 15x smartphone lens
+ 50x CPO base case for 40% share (upper end of optical peers at 14-72x).

研究部對於慧洋-KY看法正向，係因：(1) 散裝運價自8月下旬
回升，公司指數連結型船舶占比較高，將受惠運價上漲。(2) 西

輕便型船運價維持高檔。(3) 巴拿馬運河通行量減少，美灣穀物
船舶等待通行降低周轉率，市場有效運力收緊將支撐運價。(4)

加。預估2026/2027年稅後EPS 11.12元(+111.0%YoY)/8.28元
(-25.6%YoY)。以2027年預估每股淨值74.53元為評價基礎，目
前本淨比1.33倍，位於歷史評價區間0.7～2.2倍之中緣。考量
2026年獲利上修，且2027年營運展望正向，故給予1.5倍本淨
比，目標價由88.8元上調至110元，並維持買進投資評等。
